label: Flap 4.0 cm
description: The flap ticket pocket is a miniature version of the main hip pocket flap, sitting above it with a small rectangular flap matching the angle and proportion of the lower pocket for a coherent, unified appearance across the hip. It is the most casual and most visible ticket pocket option, projecting a country-sporting character that is particularly at home on tweed jackets and hacking coats. When all three pockets on the right side are cut in perfect proportion and alignment, the result is one of the defining signatures of the English hacking jacket.
